summary.text: Neil Hays is a Republican who represents Oklahoma House District 13, elected in 2022. In the 60th Legislature he is an Assistant Majority Whip.

paragraphs.text: Hays was born in Muskogee, Oklahoma, and after college returned there as a high school teacher and coach.
After more than 12 years in education he left teaching to start his own insurance agency, which now serves clients in multiple states.
He and his wife, Nicole, have six children.
